name: hero-highlight

frames.best_why: Headline, purple phrase highlight and the dotted panel are all clear, with no cursor over the text.

tagline: Dotted black hero with a lilac swipe behind a few words.
summary: A full-width dark panel covered in a faint dot grid, wrapping a headline, copy and an inline phrase marker. Moving the pointer lights a small patch of coloured dots under it.
appearance: A black full-width panel covered edge to edge in a faint dotted grid. A large white headline sits centred, with one phrase set on a lilac-to-purple rounded swipe, and a small grey line of copy beneath.
behaviour: The dot grid stays still until the pointer moves, then a soft 200px patch of brighter indigo dots follows the cursor. The phrase swipe fills its gradient in from the left once on load.
demo_content: Headline 'Build beautiful products...' and a line about a curated component library.
search_phrases: cursor spotlight over a dotted pattern
animated ink mark on a headline
dark hero with mouse following glow
pattern of small dots across a banner
use_when: A marketing hero wants a quiet dotted texture with a spotlight that tracks the pointer.
avoid_when: It needs mouse movement, so the coloured dot patch never appears on touch, and text over the dots needs care.
customise: Put your headline and copy as children; a className styles the content wrapper and containerClassName the panel. Dot colours and the 200px spotlight radius are fixed in the file.
weight_why: SVG dot layers and a masked gradient following the pointer; no canvas loop.

a11y.note: The dot spotlight only reacts to the mouse and the sweep ignores reduced-motion; the dotted texture has no text alternative.

issues: White letters on the pale lilac half of the phrase swipe are hard to read.
The cursor dot spotlight is too faint to notice in the recorded frames.
polish_why: Crisp type and a neat dot field; the phrase swipe is low contrast and the cursor effect faint.
title: Hero Highlight
